targetText: International connections may grow in scope, spreading over territories not yet drawn into the vortex of capitalist life. In that case we speak of the extensive growth of world economy. On the other hand, they may assume greater depth, become more frequent, forming, as it were, a thicker net-work. In that case we have an intensive growth of world economy.
summary: The world economy expands both extensively (through colonial annexation of non-capitalist lands) and intensively (through deeper global production ties).
explanation: Bukharin distinguishes the two dimensions of capitalist globalization: geographical expansion into precapitalist territories and the deepening interdependence of global industry, transport, and finance.
